call_points.text: Maize prices increased from ₹18 to ₹25 per kg, raising feedstock costs and putting pressure on margins.
Targeting 55 crore litres of total ethanol sales volume for FY27 including public, private OMCs, ENA, and court-ordered allocation.
EBITDA margin improved to 20.98% on a consolidated basis due to better cost control and operational efficiencies.
OMC ethanol lifting remained lower by almost 200 crore litres against estimated demand.
TruAlt integrated approximately 1,300 KLPD of dual-feed infrastructure within its total installed ethanol capacity of 2,000 KLPD.

timeline.summary: India Ratings assigned IND A-/Stable rating to TruAlt Bioenergy's ₹1,766 Cr bank facilities.
Crisil Ratings issued the Monitoring Agency Report for TruAlt Bioenergy for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, noting **₹720.21 Cr** utilized out of **₹750 Cr** IPO proceeds.
TruAlt Bioenergy scheduled its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call for May 22, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹595.52 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹59.88 Cr.
TruAlt Bioenergy released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation detailing operational performance, ethanol allocation disputes, and clean energy expansion plans.
TruAlt Bioenergy’s **Monu Kumar** shared the earnings call recording (Q4 & FY2026) on May 22, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST via the company’s website.
TruAlt Bioenergy issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval for material related party transactions up to ₹2,500 Cr with Nirani Sugars for FY26-27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹811.1 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹34.68 Cr (against a loss of ₹37.86 Cr a year earlier).
TruAlt Bioenergy reported Q2FY27 consolidated total income of ₹823.74 Cr and a net profit of ₹34.99 Cr.
